messages:
maria (product): Quick sync: seeing multiple inbound asks about tenant-specific throughput caps / per-tenant model routing guarantees. I counted 5 tickets across support/sales in last 2 weeks. Can we reconcile into one canonical request and decide response & priority? @aj @kevin (sales) @neha (eng)
aj (support): Yep — customers: ACME (req-1205), BrightHealth (req-1217), and two smaller ones. All asking for 'per-tenant token throughput' or 'hard per-tenant throttles'. ACME is blocking rollout next week. @maria
kevin (sales): ACME is on enterprise contract; they want an SLA-style throughput promise. Sales asks we either provide a documented limit or clear routing to dedicated capacity. We can't promise indefinite w/o infra changes.
neha (eng): Short answer: doable but needs infra: per-tenant qps + burst buckets + routing to Dedicated. Rough expl: add tenant-id tags at ingress -> route or throttle. PoC ~2w, production ~6-8w with tests.
simon (eng-pm): Agree with neha. Risk: autoscale pressure & multi-tenant fairness. Need to decide scope: 1) doc + recommended patterns (low-effort) 2) implement infra change (high-effort). Which do we prefer?
maria (product): Proposal: consolidate into a single 'tenant-throughput-guarantees' canonical ticket. Short-term deliverable: doc + recommended workaround + clear 'what we won't do' list. Mid-term: evaluate infra implementation as Dedicated-only feature. P1? P2? Thoughts on priority.
aj (support): For ACME I'd mark it P1 internally (blocking rollout). Others P2. We can notify ACME with workaround if we get doc + timeline.
kevin (sales): Sales prefers to push ACME to Dedicated path (we can sell reserved capacity). But need comms to explain options. +1 to doc + timeline.
neha (eng): If we do doc + workaround: I can draft steps for ops to manually configure routing to dedicated pool and a sample nginx ingress header set. That should buy time. Example snippet I can include:
```
# sample header-based routing
proxy_set_header X-Tenant-ID $http_x_tenant_id;
if ($http_x_tenant_id = "acme") {
  proxy_pass http://dedicated-pool;
}
```
maria (product): Great. Action items: - @neha draft workaround + ops playbook by Wed - @maria create canonical ticket, tag 'triage:tenant-throughput' and link all related support IDs - @kevin coordinate ACME comms - @aj notify smaller customers with templated workaround. I'll send consolidated message by EOD today. :thumbsup: 
jira-bot: Created REDWOOD-3421 'tenant-throughput-guarantees' linked to support-1205, support-1217, sales-332. Assignee: maria (product).
aj (support): ACK. I'll add ACME's required throughput numbers to the ticket now.
maria (product): Thanks team — I'll draft the reply and drop in #customer-communication for review.
